title: Millat and China's XDAO Partner for Electric Motorcycles
excerpt: Millat Industrial Products Limited has partnered with China's XDAO to boost electric motorcycle localization in Pakistan.
body_html:
Millat Industrial Products Limited (MIPL), which operates as a subsidiary of Millat Tractors Limited (MTL), has entered into a cooperation agreement with China-based XDAO.

The partnership aims to speed up the localization of electric motorcycles within Pakistan. Details regarding the financial terms, timeline, or specific production milestones of the agreement were not disclosed.
